title: Golden Pet conversion with multi-pet sacrifice and chance-based system
steps: Update PetService.convertToGoldenPet to accept a list of pet instance IDs instead of a single one
All sacrificed pets must be the same petId/type, none golden, none equipped
On success: consume all pets, return 1 golden pet (2x damage, Golden prefix)
On failure: consume all pets, return nil with failure message
Update ConvertToGoldenPet handler in Main.server.lua to pass list of IDs
Add Make Golden UI in pet inventory with selection and chance display
Add ConvertToGoldenPet remote reference in Main.client.lua
acceptance_criteria: ConvertToGoldenPet remote accepts a table of pet instance IDs
Validates all pets are same type, not golden, not equipped
Chance is calculated correctly from count (1-7 pets)
On success, all input pets are removed and 1 golden pet is created
On failure, all input pets are removed and no pet is returned
UI shows Make Golden button in pet inventory
UI allows selecting 1-7 same-type pets and shows chance percentage
